d: This episode of Tarikh dives into the dramatic night of June 21, 1941, when Adolf Hitler prepared to launch Operation Barbarossa — the largest land invasion in human history. From secret letters to Mussolini to propaganda crafted by Goebbels, the episode unpacks how Nazi Germany justified its attack on the Soviet Union. It traces the early blitzkrieg success, the brutal reality of ideological warfare, and the turning point brought by Moscow’s deadly winter.
